title: Something For Jesus 185 /
firstLine: Savior, Thy dying love Thou gavest me,

lines: Savior, Thy dying love Thou gavest me,
Nor should I aught withhold, Dear Lord, from Thee;
In love my soul would bow, My heart fulfill its vow,
Some off'ring bring Thee now, Something for Thee.
Give me a faithful heart, Likeness to Thee,
That each departing day Henceforth may see
Some work of love begun, Some deed of kindness done,
Some wand'rer sought and won, Something for Thee.
All that I am and have, Thy gifts so free,
In joy, in grief, thru life, Dear Lord, for Thee!
And when Thy face I see, My ransomed soul shall be.
Thru all eternity, Something for Thee.
